# Gate arms and checked facts

<!-- generated by scripts/gate.py report; do not edit by hand -->

The arms below are the single definition of every check: `.github/workflows/ci.yml`
runs `python scripts/gate.py <arm>`, and a local run executes the same argv.
Run the default arm with no argument (`fast`); run every distinct
check once with `all` (`syntax docs tests models gnn`).

## Arms

| Arm | Steps | What it checks |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `syntax` | `python -m compileall -q .` | Compile every module (`compileall`); the repository's only lint gate. |
| `docs` | `python scripts/check_markdown_links.py`<br>`python scripts/gate.py report --check` | Relative markdown links and heading anchors, then generated-number freshness. |
| `fast` | `python -m pytest tests -q -m not network` | Offline unit suite: `pytest tests/ -m "not network"`. |
| `tests` | `python -m pytest tests -q` | Whole unit suite: `pytest tests/`. |
| `models` | `python scripts/check_openrouter_models.py` | Model IDs exist in the live OpenRouter catalog (network). |
| `gnn` | `python scripts/check_gnn_conformance.py` | Pinned GNN conformance: install `.github/gnn-pin.json`'s parser revision, parse and type-check. |

`fast` is the offline subset of `tests` (`-m "not network"`), so `all` runs `tests` and skips `fast`.
